about: Five 4-minute VO2 reps ridden 2026-10-08 up White Crossing Road, Town of Verona, WI: from the Military Ridge State Trail crossing toward Dairy Ridge Road. Recorded at 1 Hz by a Garmin with a power meter and barometric altimeter. Trimmed to the reps: no timestamps, heart rate, or anything ridden off this road.

reps.note: slowed to ~6 km/h at 44 W about 1.19 km in, 13 m from where Gust Road joins (a side road the rider has priority over); excluded from timing checks
